choi: choi — (guess) counted; xqui choi 'they counted', not otherwise known, the sense after Brasseur 'ayant compté'; respelled by the letters
chacon: chakon — (inferred) the thing won, what is won, the stake; chac 'defeat, win' + -on (qui chacon ahauab 'what the lords have won'); once perhaps 'their defeats', after Brasseur
chaco: chako — win, beat (it); chac 'defeat, win' + -o, the ending of a transitive verb (mixe ca chaco 'we have beaten them')
coꜩih: kotz'i'j — flower; noun, the known word, the tz' supplied on the plain ligature
coꜩihal: kotz'i'jal — (inferred) of flowers, kind of flower; kotz'i'j + -al, the ending of a noun of kind or collection
huticab: jutikab' — (inferred) a bunch, one bunch; hu(n) 'one' + a measure word, after Brasseur 'un bouquet'; doubtful reading, respelled by the letters
cacamuchih: kaqamuchij — red muchih, a flower; caca 'red' + muchih, written as one word; the flower name is not explained (Brasseur's note: the chipilin kind)
muchit: muchit — muchit, a kind of flower (white muchit, yellow muchit); not explained, kept as written (Brasseur's note: the chipilin kind)
carinimac: karinimak — carinimac, a flower; not divided and not explained; respelled by the letters
rvꜩ: rutz — (inferred) its goodness, good; r- 'its' + utz 'good' (xa cu qui rvꜩ qui ꜭux 'their hearts were good, at ease'), a doubling after qui not otherwise seen
chacom: chakom — (inferred) won thing, won; chac 'win' + -om, perhaps a participle (ca chacom puch 'and our won thing')
acaba: aq'ab'a — (inferred) at night, perhaps 'early, at daybreak'; acab 'night' + -a, plain c restored as aq'ab'
pixaban: pixab'an — (inferred) counselled; pixab' 'counsel' + -an (xe pixaban quib 'they counselled one another')
catacox: q'atakox — (inferred) that they be cut; q'at 'cut' + -ak + -ox, a passive, the q' after Brasseur's g and the sense
chai: Chay — (inferred) Chai, the name of a kind of ant (Chai zanic); chai 'obsidian', 'cutting ants' after Brasseur; kept as a name
chequen: Cheken — Chequen, a kind of ant (Chequen zanic), a big night ant that cuts the stems of plants and flowers (Brasseur's note); kept as a name
ivonohel: iwonojel — all of you; iw- 'you (pl.)' + onojel 'all', as konojel
ticon: tikon — (inferred) garden, planting-place; tik 'plant' + -on (u ticon 'its garden'); written hcon in the manuscript, read with Brasseur's ticon
elecaxic: eleq'axik — being stolen, to be stolen; elec 'steal' + -ax, the passive, + -ik, the known word with the q' restored
xquina: xkina — they felt, noticed; x- completive + ki- 'they' + na 'feel', written as one word
chacala: chakala — (guess) perched, standing; perhaps the chac of chacabal; not otherwise known, Brasseur 'cheminant sur leurs jambes'; respelled by the letters
xpurpuvec: Xpurpuwek — Xpurpuvec; the call of one of the two guardian birds, kept as written (Brasseur reads it as phrases, a guess)
puhuyu: Pujuyu — Puhuyu; the call of the other bird, and the name of the two guardians; kept as a name
quina: kina — feel, notice; ki- 'they' + na 'feel', as xquina, here after ca (ca quina 'they feel')
elecai: eleq'ai — (inferred) stealing; elec 'steal' + -ai, the q' restored
chahem: chajem — (inferred) what is guarded, their charge; chah 'guard' + -em
bolovic: b'olowik — (guess) swarming; ca bolovic, a -vic verb, sense after Brasseur 'allant et revenant en troupes'; respelled by the letters
tucuvic: tukuwik — (guess) cutting; ca tucuvic, a -vic verb, sense after Brasseur 'coupant'; the letters doubtful (Brasseur tuguvic), respelled
rai: rai — (guess) unclear; perhaps r- 'its' + a noun, the flower beds (Brasseur), or the rai 'want'; left as (?)
tova: towa — (inferred) carry; ca tova vloc 'carrying hither', sense after Brasseur 'portaient'
zicou: sikow — (guess) gather, or give off scent; Brasseur ziqou 'répandaient une douce odeur'; plain c, respelled by the letters
quirixic: kirixik — (inferred) being loosed, cut loose; quir 'untie, loosen' + -ix, the passive, + -ic
zicouic: sikowik — (guess) gathered, gathering; zicou + -ic, as above
xnoh: xnoj — it was filled; x- completive + noh 'fill'
tiquitoh: tikitoj — (inferred) full, brimming; Brasseur 'tout pleins'; written hquitoh in the manuscript, read as tiquitoh
xzaquiric: xsaqirik — it dawned; x- completive + zac 'white, light' + -ir + -ic, as zaquiric
tique: tike — (guess) full, heaped (?); qui tique laon is not understood, taken with tiquitoh; respelled by the letters
laon: laon — (guess) heaped (?); qui tique laon is not understood; respelled by the letters
acabil: aq'ab'il — night; acab 'night' + -il (xa hun acabil 'in only one night'), plain c restored as aq'ab'
zaccah: saqkaj — (inferred) turned white; zac 'white' + cah, a verb of becoming; only the q of zac supplied
zacbu: saqb'u — (inferred) pale; zac 'white' + -bu, not otherwise known
xcuyu: xkuyu — (inferred) was spared, held back; x- completive + cuyu 'bear, spare, hold back'; mi na re xcuyu ca he 'not even our tails were spared' is a guess
xhix: xjix — (inferred) it was split; x- completive + hix 'split', no doer named
herebac: jereb'ak — (inferred) split; from hix, Brasseur herebak 'fendue'; respelled by the letters
purpuec: Purpuek — Purpuec; a bird with a split beak, the Xpurpuvec of the call; kept as a name
xqueleh: xkelej — (inferred) they left off, ended; perhaps x- + qu- + eleh, Brasseur 'ayant achevé'; respelled by the letters

__broaden__.cha: cha — said, say; quotative root (uncertain in this phrase 'cha ta k'ut') · cha — at your; chi 'at' + a- 'your' (cha mox 'at your left', cha wi ki q'ab' 'at your right'), inferred · cha — (guess) arrow point, flint; after Brasseur's note (cha 'the word, the arrow, and the point of the arrow, obsidian or flint'), in xa kolokik cha 'only a round flint (?)' · cha — (inferred) blade, obsidian edge, as the arrow point above (chi cha 'of the blade') · cha — you (command); ch- + a- 'you' before a verb (cha coto 'you dig') · cha — (inferred) play, game, the ball court; chaah 'play' written with one a (xcah cut qui cha 'their game began', chi cha 'at the ball court'); Brasseur takes it as 'lances'
__broaden__.xcah: xqaj — it went down; x- completive + qaj 'descend' · xkaj — they wanted; x- completive + k- (ki- 'they' before a vowel) + aj 'want', as in xraj 'he wanted' · xqaj — (inferred) it began, the game began; xcah cu chaah 'the game went down', began; Brasseur reads it the other way, 'put an end to the game'
__broaden__.cana: kana — (inferred) left behind, remaining; the root of kanaj 'remain' with -a · q'ana — (inferred) yellow; cana muchit 'yellow muchit', taken as q'ana, written with plain c (Brasseur gana)
__broaden__.ꜭux: k'u'x — heart; noun (ki k'u'x 'their heart'); root of Uk'u'x · k'ux — (inferred) gnaw, saw; the letters of k'u'x 'heart' as a verb (ca ꜭux qui he 'gnawing their tails'), after Brasseur 'scier'
__broaden__.ana: ana — (guess) perhaps; not otherwise known, sense after Brasseur 'Peut-être'; written with vi in Ana vi · ana — (inferred) where?; answered by mahabi 'there is not' (Ana vi xpe vi rilo 'where else could it have come to be seen'); Brasseur 'Où donc'
__broaden__.xic: Xik — Xic; name of a lord of Xibalba, paired with Patan; Brasseur takes it as 'hawk'; kept as a name · xik — hawk; the bird of prey (ri xik, the wak of the unit before, called by another name), as Brasseur's note says ('l'oiseau de proie appelé Xic … l'Epervier américain'); a bird here, not a lord's name · xik — wing; noun (qui xic 'their wings'), as in uxik
